source.meaning: Frozen G4A local baseline dist in artifacts/local/g4a1-baseline; no historical evidence overwritten.

occlusion.note: No cell occluder intercepted the tested centre rays. Fixed20s is an inspection pose, not a claim of complete target visibility.

comparisonScenario.method: Identical public UI actions, viewport, seed, population, identities and timeline. Complete camera and canvas dimensions are recorded; changed tracking framing is disclosed by the index, never mislabeled as identical camera.

limitations: Centre-ray occlusion differs from full surface visibility.
